== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-10-reaper|The Skysworn are a group of [[sacred artists]] serving the [[Blackflame Empire]], acting as an imperial police force, wandering judges, and [[peacekeepers]]. They are tasked with upholding the rule of law, investigating negligence, and punishing criminals or managing dangerous entities like spirits. While they generally avoid the minor conflicts between clans to prevent imperial intervention, they possess the Authority{{!}}authority to take individuals into custody in the name of the Emperor. The organization is composed of various ranks, including Truegold{{!}}Truegolds and Lowgold{{!}}Lowgolds, and its members are trained to compete with one another. Historically, the Emperor himself served within their ranks, and many great heroes of the empire began as Skysworn. The Skysworn operate from a massive [[cloud fortress]] known as [[Stormrock]], which functions like a floating city. Their headquarters is located within [[Starsweep Tower]]. Members are often identified by their green armor or green robes, and they utilize Thousand-Mile Cloud{{!}}Thousand-Mile Clouds for travel. In combat or official duties, they may use specialized equipment such as green [[constructs]] and various striking techniques. The group is highly active and often stretched thin due to the high demand for their services across the empire.}}

== Skysworn ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|The Skysworn are an elite sect of [[sacred artists]] within the [[Blackflame Empire]] who serve the Emperor as protectors dedicated to preserving justice and the rule of law. Clad in green plate armor, these warriors guard an outer door and maintain a city that houses students and a [[Soulsmith]] [[library]]. After transporting individuals to their mountain via a [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]], the group took [[Lindon]] into observation following his departure from [[Serpent's Grave]]. While they hold ceremonies to welcome trainees, the group maintains a dislike for Blackflame{{!}}Blackflames and may eventually consider [[Lindon]] and [[Yerin]] to be wanted fugitives. During a conflict with [[Redmoon Hall]], the Skysworn engaged in direct combat, even as [[Eithan]] attempted to influence the sect by linking Underlord{{!}}Underlords to them.}}

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Empowered by The Empire{{!}}the Empire to act as wandering judges, the Skysworn are a group of Authority{{!}}authority that recognizes Mu Enkai{{!}}Enkai's defense of his town. After [[Eithan]] leaves [[Lindon]] and his companions in their care, the group responds to reports of a disturbance near the facility. During these events, they lend [[Lindon]] the [[Thousand-Mile Cloud]] and prevent [[Yerin]] from passing through a [[portal]]. The Skysworn arrive alongside [[dragons]] from the [[Blackflame Empire]], and they maintain a status where no additional Authority{{!}}authority is granted over them. Eventually, [[Lindon]] serves on one of their squads, while [[Eithan]] expresses a desire to join the organization.}}

== Underlord ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|The Skysworn are an organization of warriors composed of trainees and Truegold{{!}}Truegolds who utilize [[Striker techniques]]. Operating from their flying city known as [[Stormrock]], these agents maintain a presence throughout The Empire{{!}}the Empire and patrol the borders of [[Blackflame Empire]] territory. The group provides scouting missions and utilizes identical rooms within their tower, though superior accommodations are reserved for those above the rank of trainee. While [[Lindon]] has performed missions for the organization and can contact them via his [[communication construct]], the group has also been involved in devastating [[Eithan]]'s partners. During recent conflicts, small squads of the Skysworn pursued [[Lindon]]'s group and responded to a distress signal while under attack, though they eventually managed to escape.}}
